# Review — kebra-nagast-ch44 (ch. 44)

Reviewer: strongest model, adversarial. No modern translation, no web; Dillmann not available, so lexical calls are hedged (?). Units are numbered from 0 (unit 0 is the chapter heading), in the order of units.json. The Geʿez `t` was not touched (checked: every word of `t` has a gloss or known-form entry; no unit exceeds 35 words).

### Pass 1 — findings refused

- Unit 6 `i` 'in the afterlife' for ወበሰማያትኒ: an interpretation, but the note says so openly ('must mean the next world'); a literal 'in the heavens' would mislead. Kept.
- Unit 0 label 'infinitive in the construct' for ሐምየ: not verifiable without Dillmann, and consistent with the construct reading before ንጉሥ. Kept.
- Unit 9 `i` 'likenesses of the prophets': stiff but faithful to አምሳለ; `l` shows the construct. Kept.
- Unit 17 `i` 'the peoples' for አሕዛብ (laity?): no evidence for another sense. Kept.
- Unit 21 ተምዕዖ ('was angry with', ለ-): suffix plus ለ- doubling matches the house pattern; kept with the gloss (?).
- Unit 6/22 ሠጠጠ 'tore': no Dillmann to check; the sense fits 1 Samuel 15:28. Kept.
- Unit 3 subject 'God' of ኢያሀጒል: kept, now carried by (?) in `i`.
- Unit 5 `n` repeated mention of the accusative -a: redundant but harmless. Kept.
- Unit 7 `n` on ፨ as a section mark: harmless. Kept.
- Unit 12 `n` 'compare Matthew 5:15' for ማኅቶት: correct (the lamp saying). Kept.
- Unit 26 `n`: unit is not over the ~45-word limit, so no cut at ፤ was made.
